title: Tom's Day
text:
Tom likes sports. He runs in the park every morning. He jumps and kicks a ball with his friends. He throws the ball to his friend Ali.

After lunch, Tom reads a book. He writes a short story in his notebook. Then he climbs the stairs to his room. He goes to sleep early at night.

questions.text: What does Tom do every morning?
What does Tom write in his notebook?
Why is Tom probably tired at the end of the day?
options: He did very little all day
He ran, jumped and played sports
He stayed in bed all day

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom probably?

vocabulary.definition: hits a ball with the foot
a book with empty pages for writing notes
goes up something using the hands and feet

paragraph_translations: Tom sporu sever. Her sabah parkta koşar. Arkadaşlarıyla bir topa vurur ve tekme atar. Topu arkadaşı Ali'ye atar.
Öğle yemeğinden sonra Tom bir kitap okur. Defterine kısa bir hikâye yazar. Sonra odasına merdivenlerden tırmanır. Geceleri erken uyur.
